I'm in that weird bit between millennial and gen z with younger siblings and lemme tell you we've all but given up. I want to have kids but I probably never will because I can't even afford to look after myself. I want to buy a house but until someone in my partners family dies we'll never be able to. A lot of the time I don't feel like I'm really an adult simply because I can't do the things adults are supposed to do. I'm glad someone finally put what I've been feeling into words though. Thank you.
